comparison.objective: Disconnects a pneumatic tube safely and inserts a retaining plug after isolation, lockout, and depressurization; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1784 requires valve and padlock operation, collet depression, tube withdrawal, tool handling, and plug insertion; the candidate requires concentric threaded countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1784 checks safe history, zero pressure, line removal, plug seating, and a 15 N retention pull; the candidate checks a retained opening angle through actuation cycles.
comparison.reason: Both end with retained hardware, but pneumatic lockout and push-fitting service test different mechanisms and manipulation abilities.
